changes: Fix: names and numbers no longer cover pop-ups such as pattern select (PTN).
A cell is drawn only where the stock TRK label and fader ticks are still in view.
First release: the Internal Mixer shows each track's name from SETUP > RENAME in place of TRK1..TRK16.
The mixer shows the first 5 characters; a track still named PRESET n keeps its stock label.
Each fader has its track number in an inverted box at its top left.
Names follow the pattern's kit, so every pattern has its own. The mod only draws: it saves nothing.
